fact: Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance held a five-day ICDL-aligned digital skills training (Computer and Online Essentials, Digital Marketing) for communication officers from government MDAs, with further ICDL modules set for July 2025.

fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance launched a Digital Literacy and Skilling Training for local government officers, with ITU and UICT, covering computer and mobile use, cybersecurity and the PDMIS and FIS systems, starting online.

The MoFPED monitoring report says the Uganda Institute of Information and Communications Technology (UICT) trained 2,268 Government officers in FY 2024/25 in areas including Digital Leadership, Data Science and Analytics, and Digital Literacy and General ICT Awareness.

fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance says it concluded, with MultiChoice Uganda, a strategic communications and digital skills training of 7-10 July 2025 for over 200 government communications officers, under a 2024 MoU on public-sector digital literacy.
